spec.selection: Development league points, then worst-profile points rate, then survival nights, then score; no holdout reselection
spec.drawPolicy: Draws count as draws, never wins; report half matches and paired fixtures separately
limitations: This is a partial local simulator, not the official judge
Robot wave sizes, spawning, pathing and target priority are hypotheses
Tasks, task rewards, treasure, world news and direct player damage are omitted
Kill credit for simultaneous multi-team hits uses most damage as a local convention
Vacated-cell movement chains succeed; contested destinations and position swaps fail; robot path selection remains hypothetical
Summons apply to the next night, with the ten-per-day cap shared across the team
The fixture score includes combat and survival only; task score is zero for all candidates
